Laurie's granddaughter who faces Michael in 2018–2022.

How Allyson Nelson connects

  • Faction: Strode family — Allyson is Laurie's granddaughter in that same line.
  • Work: Halloween (2018) — Allyson is pulled into Michael's 2018 return.

What is Allyson Nelson?

Key threads lead to Strode family and Halloween (2018).
